procurement_section_observations.finding: Procurement of 13,500 face shields at ₱58.00/pc exceeded DOH Suggested Retail Prices.
Emergency procurement of medicine supplies lacked mandatory GPPB supporting documents.
Construction materials for 9 barangay MRFs split into Small Value Procurement instead of public bidding.
Purchase of 10 laptops for SB members split into two transactions under Small Value Procurement.
Notices of Award and Purchase Orders for goods omitted from PhilGEPS posting.
Approved Budgets for Contracts omitted from Requests for Quotation sent to suppliers.
Meals and snacks procured through SVP without adopting a Framework Agreement.
Direct hiring of 6 consultants performing duties assignable to regular staff without competitive bidding.
Direct hiring of technical consultants without undergoing proper competitive procurement.

procurement_section_observations.title: Procurement and installation of CCTV Cameras totaling ₱1,152,740.00 awarded to supplier whose goods were outside its registered line of business
procurement_section_observations.summary: Alphin Trading and Construction supplied CCTV cameras despite BIR COR only covering retail sale of construction supplies. Violates Section 63.3 of IRR of RA No. 12009.
procurement_section_observations.recommendation: Disqualify bidders whose registered line of business does not match procured goods.

procurement_section_observations.title: Various ICT equipment, construction supplies, and refrigerator amounting to ₱504,681.00 procured with brand names in technical specifications
procurement_section_observations.summary: Brand names (Asus, Apple, Samsung, Acer, LG, Boysen, Sonak) specified in PRs and RFQs. Violates Section 11 of IRR of RA No. 12009.
procurement_section_observations.recommendation: Prohibit tailor-fitting specs to specific brands; ensure performance-based, functional, generic specs.

procurement_section_observations.title: Meals and snacks totaling ₱6,117,351.10 procured through Small Value Procurement without due consideration of Framework Agreement
procurement_section_observations.summary: Repeated SVP for meals/snacks throughout 2025 (Jan-Dec). Deprived LGU of benefits under GPPB Resolution No. 27-2019. May constitute splitting of requisitions. Reiteration of prior year finding.
procurement_section_observations.recommendation: Consider adopting Framework Agreement for procurement of meals and snacks.

procurement_section_observations.title: Non-preparation of Procurement Monitoring Report by BAC within 14 calendar days after end of each semester
procurement_section_observations.summary: No PMR submitted to GPPB. Municipality excluded from GPPB List of Compliant Procuring Entities for H1 FY 2025 due to failure to adopt NGPA.
procurement_section_observations.recommendation: BAC to prepare and submit Procurement Monitoring Report to GPPB.

procurement_section_observations.title: Payment of Hazard Pay totaling ₱110,550.62 for CY 2025 not supported with proof of actual services rendered under hazardous conditions
procurement_section_observations.summary: MSWDOs and SWOs granted hazard pay without supporting documents. Only November justified (State of Calamity). Paid on commutable basis.
procurement_section_observations.recommendation: Discontinue commutable hazard pay; require refund of ₱110,550.62.

procurement_section_observations.title: Procurement of one Gaming Laptop amounting to ₱115,000.00 for Assessor's Office despite availability of less expensive units
procurement_section_observations.summary: ASUS TUF F15 gaming laptop procured for GIS operations. Brand-specific PR/RFQ. Unnecessary expenditure under COA Circular No. 2012-003.
procurement_section_observations.recommendation: Submit justification; issue memorandum prohibiting tailor-fitting of specs.

infrastructure_section_observations.finding: Initial failure to collect liquidated damages for delayed completion on the municipal motorpool contract.
Multiple contracts awarded to bidders with duplicate key personnel and equipment committed simultaneously.
Infrastructure contracts awarded without DOLE-approved Construction Safety and Health Programs.
Completed DPWH road project unrecorded in municipal books until official inspection in July 2024.
Lawin Ave drainage canal misposted as Road Networks instead of Flood Control System.
Asphalt repairs improperly booked as asset capital expenditures under Road Networks.

infrastructure_section_observations.title: CIP - Buildings and Other Structures account balance does not reconcile with actual ongoing projects
infrastructure_section_observations.summary: Discrepancy of ₱1,096,244.18 between financial statement balance (₱509,755.82) and actual project costs (₱1,606,000.00 for Golden Child Dev Center Phase 2). Accountant failed to record 60% work accomplishment.
infrastructure_section_observations.recommendation: Prepare adjusting journal entries to record unrecorded CIP-Buildings and Accounts Payable.

infrastructure_section_observations.title: Other Receivables account totaling ₱617,014.91 not supported with detailed schedules and includes ₱613,635.81 dormant for more than 10 years
infrastructure_section_observations.summary: Receivables from 1992-2025 lack subsidiary ledgers and supporting documents. Seven accounts total ₱613,635.81 dormant for 27-33 years.
infrastructure_section_observations.recommendation: Locate documents; request COA authority to write-off dormant receivables.

infrastructure_section_observations.title: Donations in kind totaling ₱263,995.00 not supported with complete documentation
infrastructure_section_observations.summary: Aircon, construction supplies, and other items donated to barangays/schools lacking proof of request, acknowledgement receipts, or with mismatched quantities.
infrastructure_section_observations.recommendation: Require complete supporting documents prior to grant of donations in kind.

infrastructure_section_observations.title: Various GAD PPAs totaling ₱4,527,500.00 did not clearly address gender-related issues
infrastructure_section_observations.summary: Programs charged to GAD fund: Financial Assistance under AICS (₱994,500), Clean and Green (₱630,000), Sports Development (₱2,150,000), Educational Assistance (₱153,000), Plaza maintenance (₱600,000). GAD AR submitted late without supporting docs.
infrastructure_section_observations.recommendation: Identify gender-responsive projects before inclusion in GPB; submit lacking documentary requirements.
